|birth = {{ne|664}}}}'''Ivara''' is a [[Kin]] elder and a member of the [[Knitting Circle]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ivara}} She is a goldsmith.

== Appearance ==
She is dark and looks [[Tairen]]. She has plump hands and white in her hair.

== Activities ==
Her Saidar strength is {{opsl|45}}, strong enough to become Aes Sedai. She went to the in {{ne|680}} and spent twelve years as a [[novice]]. However, she refused her test for [[Accepted]] three times, and was put out of the [[White Tower]].

She is in a meeting with the rest of the Knitting Circle when [[Elayne Trakand]] and the rest of her group arrive, looking for the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

She traveled firstly to the [[farm]] and later to [[Andor]] with the majority of Kinswomen in Ebou Dar.
